claims.title: P1 task-contrast causal interfaces and task fidelity

quoted_fields.interface: A task-contrast causal interface conditionally makes redesigned terminal-action choice robust to arbitrary upstream hidden histories,with explicit physical/statistical error and task-preservation gates. Original killed-excursion/two-mode results remain valid;the original unmodified rare-mode problem is not solved.
quoted_fields.failure: Original governing note and separate checker now acquired;no P1 continuation archive was visible. Uniform all-hidden-state leakage,downstream model/preparation/decoding and task-semantic preservation remain physically unearned. The cut changes the terminal operation and does not identify original E[p^74 a]. No independent scientific review,experimental realization,biological operation,novelty or estimator superiority.

claims.title: P2 bounded-likelihood noise interventions from partial physics

quoted_fields.interface: Original framework gives a likelihood-corrected terminal rare-event estimator under a qualified invariant programmable noise port and pathwise upper dynamics,with conditional finite-sample decisions and exact finite-alphabet/synthetic evidence. The first model-free controller loses to an equal-data DP baseline;the final equally informed ordinary Doob transform ties exactly.
quoted_fields.failure: Original bundle,note,code,reported outputs and diagnostics are acquired as data,not replayed or independently reviewed. Controlled-reachable global dominance,invariant full innovation laws,independent preparation and computable monotone H are essential. Terminal risk differs from hitting risk;one-sided B alone gives no uniform relative efficiency. Gaussian finite-bit likelihood,physical port,costs/scalability and practical advantage remain open.
